name: B10-0442/2025 (ECR) – Arbitrary detention of EU citizens Javier Marañón Montero and David Rodríguez Ballesta in Equatorial Guinea
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the arbitrary detention of EU citizens Javier Marañón Montero and David Rodríguez Ballesta in Equatorial Guinea
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making requests. It calls on Equatorial Guinea to release two Spanish citizens, Javier Marañón Montero and David Rodríguez Ballesta, held without proper process. It demands urgent medical evacuation for Marañón Montero, whose health is critical after a hunger strike. It also asks the country to treat all prisoners humanely, give them fair trials and let them see lawyers and family.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only asks Equatorial Guinea to act.
- **Who it affects:** Two detained Spanish citizens and other prisoners in Equatorial Guinea.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to the Council, the United Nations, the African Union and Equatorial Guinea's authorities.
